query_original: What is the maximum number of team personnel allowed access to the Parc Fermé area per F1 Car, and for what purpose?
resposta: According to Article 22.4 of the FIA F1 2026 Technical Regulations, a maximum of three (3) team personnel per F1 Car will be permitted access to the Parc Fermé area for the sole purpose of fitting cooling fans and undertaking any work required by those officials charged with supervision of parc fermé.
